run_evaluate_checkpoint: run evaluation of a Videoseal checkpoint on a dataset with configurable augmentations and metrics
run_evaluate_videos: run watermark detection and decoding evaluation on video data with quality metrics like PSNR, SSIM, VMAF
run_evaluate_images: run watermark robustness evaluation on image data with augmentation-based bit accuracy and p-value metrics
run_evaluate_with_augmentations: run evaluation with validation augmentations to test watermark robustness under various transformations
run_evaluate_with_bdrate: run evaluation computing BD-rate between original and watermarked video content using VMAF scores
